evals.prompt: Find duplicate photos in ./fixtures/photos and tell me which to keep.
evals.expected_output: Report the byte-identical PNG pair and resized JPEG near-match; recommend a full-resolution PNG with evidence, leaving all inputs unchanged.
expectations: Runs eidolon on the requested fixtures, rather than relying only on ad-hoc hashes.
Correctly maps report files and relations: copy.png/original.png are identical, and small.jpg is a lower-resolution near-match.
Preserves all fixture paths and bytes; performs no input move or deletion.
Recommends copy.png or original.png with a full-resolution quality rationale and leaves deletion decisions to the user.

evals.prompt: Are any of these videos in ./fixtures/videos the same clip? Tell me which version to keep before I clean up.
evals.expected_output: Report original.mp4 and small.mp4 as the same footage with different encoding/resolution, keep different.mp4 separate, and recommend original.mp4 without changing files.
expectations: Runs eidolon on the requested fixtures, rather than relying only on ad-hoc hashes.
Correctly reads the report: original.mp4/small.mp4 share footage, and different.mp4 is outside their duplicate group.
Preserves all fixture paths and bytes; performs no input move or deletion.
Recommends original.mp4 with a higher-resolution quality rationale and leaves deletion decisions to the user.
